budgets.title: totalling every team costs one pass over the rows
budgets.why: The current code finds the teams with one pass and then re-scans the whole dataset once per team, so five teams cost six passes. The totals can all be accumulated while reading each row once.

budgets.title: resolving 40 ids costs one pass over the rows
budgets.why: The current code scans from the start for every id, so cost grows with lookups times rows. One pass can build what every lookup then needs.

budgets.title: a missing id costs no more than a present one
budgets.why: A miss currently scans the entire dataset before giving up, so the worst input is the one where nothing is found. Absence should be as cheap to establish as presence.
